prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a multi-lane roadway in League City, Texas, when the vehicle attempted to change lanes to the right. Driver 2 was operating a vehicle in the right lane, and the two vehicles made contact along their adjacent sides during the lane change. Officers arrived and observed that the damage to both vehicles was consistent with the reported sideswipe, with scrape marks and displaced trim running along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and matching contact on Driver 2's left side. No earlier damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to officers or noted during the inspection. Driver 1 was identified as the named insured on the policy for the vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck strain and stated that the impact jolted their head and upper body forward and back. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both responding officers and a second party on scene confirmed that presence. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the reported details, although no independent witnesses to the collision were located. The reported injury appeared to match the direction and force of the impact as observed at the scene.
